title: Domains
description: Give your artist website and store their own addresses.
notice: Saving a domain starts a private connection request. Keep your current DNS records until ownership, hosting and HTTPS have been confirmed. A website and a store need separate hostnames.

steps.title: Add your address
steps.description: Enter a domain you own. Add each hostname separately, including www or a shop subdomain if needed.

steps.title: Verify ownership
steps.description: Follow the exact verification instructions provided for this request. Do not change existing records without confirmed instructions.

steps.title: Connect hosting
steps.description: Confirm the destination: artist website or artist store. The correct hosting target must be supplied before DNS changes.

steps.title: Enable secure access
steps.description: The connection becomes active only after ownership and HTTPS are confirmed. Domain renewal stays with your registrar.

surfaces.label: Artist website
surfaces.description: Your artist pages, music, gallery and projects.

surfaces.label: Artist store
surfaces.description: Your shop and product pages, separate from your website.
